frame: legacy-v06 (same glyph-local frame as A/B/G/R/S, y down)

provenance.author: Claude (AI), NIGHTSHIFT implementation session
provenance.method: Original hand-authored line/quadratic contours drawn to match the existing A/B/G/R/S family: stroke and wall thickness about 25 units, chamfered C/G/O family, curved B/D/P/R bowls, cap height 8–132. Not traced or derived from any font, artwork, photograph or identifiable writer.

notes: Never edit by hand without bumping version; geometry changes after import go through editor commands.
The legacy v0.6 provisional base of each glyph is kept as a reference-only second variant.

C.brief: Chamfered open bowl in the C/G/O family: upper and lower arcs ending in horizontal terminals with vertical end caps; exterior-connected aperture on the right, no bar (distinguishes it from G) and no closed counter (distinguishes it from O).

D.brief: Straight spine with one curved bowl in the B/P/R bowl family; one enclosed counter.

O.brief: Chamfered closed bowl in the C/G/O family; one enclosed counter with chamfered corners echoing the outer silhouette.

P.brief: Spine with an upper curved bowl matching R; open lower structure (stem only below the bowl); one enclosed counter.

Q.brief: The O construction plus an explicit diagonal tail leaving the lower-right chamfer outward (perpendicular to the chamfer). The tail is part of the outer contour, never enters the counter, and descends below the baseline.
